problem: A live i18n release can inherit the correct route-aware runtime from an ancestor commit while a later closure-only main commit does not retrigger the browser readback.
root_cause: Runtime and closure commits were split by concurrent reconciliations. The site was live with the runtime fix, but terminal proof needed a fresh runtime-bearing commit so production readback could execute against the exact deployed lineage.
prevention: Terminal website closure must end on a runtime-bearing commit when the final acceptance criterion is browser behavior.
The i18n asset version is rotated so browsers and CDN fetch the exact final runtime.
Production readback must verify same-page NL↔EN behavior after the exact runtime-bearing deployment.
